commit.message: fix(ci): stop docs-prohibited-patterns from misclassifying template-*.md as temp files (TP-DMX-DOCS-PROHIBITED-PATTERN-MATCHER-001)

pr.title: fix(ci): docs-prohibited-patterns no longer flags template-*.md as temp files
pr.body: Root cause: the *temp*.md glob substring-matches 'temp' inside 'template', so legitimate template asset filenames (e.g. docs/pr_prep/adapters/vibe/template-agent.md, renamed from agent-template.md in commit 139944337a specifically to avoid this hook) are misclassified as prohibited temporary files. This packet extracts the inline bash matcher to scripts/ci/docs_prohibited_patterns.sh, fixes the classification so any filename containing 'template' is treated as a template asset (not a temp/scratch file) before the temp/notes/todo/scratch prohibition is applied, and adds deterministic regression tests (tests/ci/test_docs_prohibited_patterns.py) covering both the allow-list (template-*.md variants) and the deny-list (temp.md, temp-foo.md, my-temp-file.md, temporary.md, notes*.md, todo.md, scratch*.md). No policy loosening: real temp/scratch/notes/todo filenames remain blocked, verified by the new tests and by a live pre-commit run against docs/scratch/temp-check.md.
